items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Oh, I played in practically every one he ever had

ctx.x: An' we been in an' out...have...have played some dates with Johnny Otis's band...me and Eddie Vinson "Cleanhead"...an' I played some dates with Joe Houston...Joe Houston and his Sorrelles (?) Quartet...have a bunch o' girls called Sorrelles (?). We played with them. And then...went out an' played California here a long time ago. Gittin' back behind now.
Well, Billy Bergs used to have a nightclub here.
Which one of Billy Berg's clubs did you play? Or did you play more than one?
